No header, symbol, message, or other declared interface element of cv_bridge changes. The maintainer calls #419 "the PR that was breaking API in foxy and galactic" (https://github.com/ros-perception/vision_opencv/issues/485#issuecomment-1250403595), but the primary diff is build-system only, so it is classified by the diff.
